issue.title: Actionable ACE-run pruning notifications with a restorable prune review
issue.description: Pressing Enter on an ACE-run pruning notification opens a polished review that, once confirmed, moves exactly the reviewed and still-eligible runs into a restorable trash in the background. Protections are re-verified before every move and again before any permanent purge.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/actionable_run_prune_notifications.md requests this work

issue.title: Rust run-trash contract in sase-core
issue.description: core_quarantine: add a sase-core module that quarantines confirmed ACE-run dirs into a journaled, restorable trash by atomic rename, re-checking every protection first. It also lists, restores, and protection-verifies purges, with PyO3 bindings and tests. The unattended apply refusal stays.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/actionable_run_prune_notifications.md defines phase core_quarantine as one work unit

issue.title: Python facade, review snapshots, and CLI apply/restore
issue.description: trash_callers: ratchet the core pin, add the Python facade and the review-snapshot payload module, make `prune-runs --apply` quarantine fresh-intersect-reviewed runs, and post a result notification. `artifact trash` gains run batches, and the artifact index stays consistent.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/actionable_run_prune_notifications.md defines phase trash_callers as one work unit

issue.title: Hourly preview emits an actionable, beautiful notification
issue.description: preview_notification: the chop purges expired batches, writes a review snapshot, and attaches the review payload. It redesigns the report with project display names and per-project rows, supersedes stale previews, and drops the "preview-only" copy.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/actionable_run_prune_notifications.md defines phase preview_notification as one work unit

issue.title: TUI prune review modal behind notification Enter
issue.description: review_modal: route Enter on payload-bearing report notifications to a new prune review modal with ready, blocked, missing, and running states. On confirm it submits the CLI apply as a durable proc and reports completion. Includes badges, footer, help, visual snapshots, and an end-to-end fixture test.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/actionable_run_prune_notifications.md defines phase review_modal as one work unit
